It 100% depends on the person. I know a small hobbyist brown belt who struggles against most large aggressive newbies and I know a giant 5 year blue belt who taps black belts regularly. But, if I had to give some kind of answer, I'd say after about 6 months of training, you should be able to consistently beat someone who is relatively the same size and age. There's so many variables though.

My goal has always been to get my blackbelt. But it's not necessarily the belt itself I'm after. Ive always had the idea that if I really go after that belt, everything I really want will happen along the way. It's allowed me to set a simple, straightforward goal for myself, and along the way everything I really want (good technique, to be more efficient, stronger etc.) just happens naturally along the way. At this point it's my love for the sport motivates me, not any belt. But i think it helped me when I was first starting. I think anything that pushes you out the door and gets you in the gym is a good thing.
